text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Tuesday:

- Swiss Jewish Community president Rolf Bloch said at the opening of the Simon Wiesenthal Conference in Geneva that the conference should be used as a base for an international investigation into Nazi gold and not just as a platform for criticism of Switzerland.
- Swiss university graduates favour careers in multi-national companies, according to a study by Swedish market researcher Universum. The most desirable companies were ABB, Nestle, and Swissair.
